import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.nextLine();
        // Simulate Python's rstrip() (remove trailing whitespace)
        s = s.replaceAll("\\s+$", "");
        
        if (s.length() >= 2) {
            // First step: replace all "dot" with "." in the substring excluding first and last chars
            String middle = s.substring(1, s.length() - 1).replace("dot", ".");
            s = s.charAt(0) + middle + s.charAt(s.length() - 1);
            
            // Second step: replace first occurrence of "at" with "@" in the new substring excluding first and last chars
            String newMiddle = s.substring(1, s.length() - 1).replaceFirst("at", "@");
            s = s.charAt(0) + newMiddle + s.charAt(s.length() - 1);
        }
        
        System.out.println(s);
    }
}
